// The worked example on periskopos.com (docs/protocol/supabase-example) shows
// this getMetrics(); keep the two the same. test/protocol.test.ts type-checks it
// under Deno, inside the generated template, against the real supabase-js.
export async function getMetrics(): Promise<Metric[]> {
  const supabase = await admin();

  const { count: saved, error: savedError } = await supabase
    .from("saved_items")
    .select("*", { count: "exact", head: true });
  if (savedError) throw savedError;

  // Accounts live in Supabase Auth: count them page by page.
  const weekAgo = Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000;
  let accounts = 0;
  let signupsThisWeek = 0;
  for (let page = 1; ; page++) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.admin.listUsers({ page, perPage: 1000 });
    if (error) throw error;
    accounts += data.users.length;
    signupsThisWeek += data.users.filter((u) => Date.parse(u.created_at) >= weekAgo).length;
    if (data.users.length < 1000) break;
  }

  return [
    { id: "users", label: "Accounts", value: accounts },
    { id: "saved_items", label: "Saved items", value: saved ?? 0 },
    { id: "signups_week", label: "Sign-ups this week", value: signupsThisWeek, hint: "last 7 days" },
  ];
}
